sentences.en: The map layer overlies the geological data.
sentences.zh: 地图层置于地质数据之上。

sentences.en: The old building overlied on top of an ancient temple site.
sentences.zh: 那座老建筑建在古代寺庙遗址上面。

sentences.en: Her fears overlie all her actions, even when she’s happy.
sentences.zh: 即使她很开心，她的恐惧也笼罩着所有行动。

senses.zh: 躺在…上面； 置于…上面
